title: Degree and passport names differ: what to check
description: Compare the records and identify the responsible issuer before making changes.
answer: Identify which record is correct and which institution issued the record that needs attention. Never alter an official document yourself or assume an affidavit is a universal solution.

sections.title: Make a simple comparison
sections.text: Write the name exactly as it appears on the degree, passport and identity record. Note missing names, spelling differences and any formal name change. Keep this comparison private.

sections.title: Ask the responsible issuer
sections.text: A university answers questions about its academic record. The passport authority handles passport records. The identity authority handles identity records. One office cannot automatically correct another office’s document.

sections.title: Ask the recipient what it accepts
sections.text: The organisation receiving the document may ask for a corrected record, evidence of a name change or other supporting information. Get its answer in writing before purchasing additional services.

sections.title: Avoid shortcuts
sections.text: Do not erase, overwrite or digitally edit a name on an official document. A declaration does not itself change the source record, and its acceptance depends on the recipient.

sections.title: Begin with a description
sections.text: An initial enquiry can simply say which documents differ and what the difference is. Leave out passport numbers, identity numbers, birth dates and scans until the handling arrangements are clear.

author: SK Attestation Services
